title: CPU Sigma-Delta baseline
scope: Deterministic channel-major signed 16-bit CPU Sigma-Delta router with accumulator carry, ternary spikes, histogram and sparsity receipt.

verification.notes: The first shared invocation exhausted the workspace disk while other workers compiled concurrently; the code path was not reported as a Rust failure.

limitations: This is a deterministic CPU reference baseline; no hardware SDNN or performance claim is made.
Input is channel-major and bounded by explicit channel and sample limits.
